form.label: Microsoft Windows Sysmon - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Windows Sysmon XML relay overview for process, network, image-load, process-access, file creation/time-change, DNS, registry, named-pipe, and process-tampering, WMI filter/consumer/binding, driver-load, remote-thread, raw-access, clipboard-change, and file-delete-detected records. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.
